2. It is submitted by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor that the charge sheet has been laid against the petitioners, vide CS No. 4/2024 dated 31.01.2024, in connection with Bakalia PS Case No. 06/2024, under Sections 120(B)/498A/489B/489C/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.

The petitioners are at liberty to approach the jurisdictional Court, and apply for bail, if so advised,
which may be considered by the learned Court as per law.
